row.title: A cadence test must state its own free-tier snapshot, never read the live one
row.body: test_ideas read the committed ops/free-tier.json, so it failed on main whenever the live account was over a limit (D1 reads at 6.6x the limit read as shed, cap 0). The sandbox now writes a deterministic snapshot at T. Session: session_0156nqDuSa1pdM6rAaTQ1irE
